elements.title: Voltex
elements.subtitle: A tech mod running on FE

elements.text: You start by crushing ore and setting up your first machines. Later you build a heat network, multiblocks and the magnet, and at the very end you assemble the Dyson panel.
This panel explains how each machine works and what unlocks what. There are no recipes here, only what you need to know to get a machine running.
Almost every machine is made from a **machine casing**, so start there. Your first power comes from the **coal generator**: throw coal in and it starts feeding the machines next to it.
Next you want a **crusher** and an **electric furnace**. The crusher turns ore into dust, and the furnace smelts the dust into ingots.
Do not smelt ore straight away. Put it in the crusher first: one ore gives two dust, while a furnace would give you one ingot. Smelt the dust and you get twice the metal from every ore.
Later the **ore washer** gives even more: three dust per ore and sometimes a rare metal on top.
Every machine runs on **FE**. A generator makes it, a cable carries it to the machines, and each machine keeps a small reserve and spends it while working.
If a machine keeps stopping and starting, it is short on power: either the generator is too weak or the cable cannot carry enough. A better cable carries more.
